name: The Ironhold Confederacy
personality: Ironhold values strength above all. They respect power and despise weakness. They will expand aggressively, form alliances only when tactically necessary, and betray partners the moment a better opportunity arises.

name: The Verdant Pact
personality: The Verdant Pact believes harmony between civilizations is the path to prosperity. They prefer trade and alliances over war, will always attempt diplomacy first, and hold grudges for a very long time when betrayed.

name: The Ashborne Merchant Guild
personality: The Guild has no permanent friends or enemies — only permanent interests. Every decision is a calculation of cost and benefit. They will trade with anyone, betray anyone, and smile while doing it.

name: The Silent Conclave
personality: The Conclave speaks little and observes everything. They will spend the first half of the simulation seemingly doing nothing — building strength in silence. Then they act decisively and without warning. They never explain their reasoning.
